latest_commit.message:
ANDROID: gki_defconfig: Build with DPM watchdog

Compile the DPM watchdog into the kernel to detect lockups during
suspend/resume, but leave it disabled by default.

Set the following timeout values:
- CONFIG_DPM_WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT=25
- CONFIG_DPM_WATCHDOG_WARNING_TIMEOUT=10

These values are chosen based on ChromeOS experience (b/474256297) to
ensure the DPM watchdog triggers a panic and dumps debug information
before any hardware watchdog (typically ~30s) resets the system.

Importantly, CONFIG_DPM_WATCHDOG_ENABLED is explicitly left unset.
This ensures the watchdog is compiled into the GKI kernel but remains
disabled by default, preventing unexpected panics on devices that are
unaware of the DPM watchdog.  Individual platforms can safely opt-in
by passing `pm.dpm_watchdog_enabled=1` via the kernel command line.
